title: Anthropic Launches Claude Ship to Review, Fix, and Approve Code - Slashdot
excerpt: Anthropic has unveiled Claude Ship, a new feature in Claude Code that allows AI agents to review pull requests, fix bugs, resolve merge conflicts and approve code changes according to policies established by development teams. 9to5Mac reports: Claude Ship is comprised of three agents: Code Review, ...
content_html: Anthropic has unveiled Claude Ship, a new feature in Claude Code that allows AI agents to review pull requests, fix bugs, resolve merge conflicts and approve code changes according to policies established by development teams. 9to5Mac reports: Claude Ship is comprised of three agents: Code Review, PR Steward, and Claude Approvals. "Together, they take a pull request through review, fixes, and an approval decision so teams don't have to manage each step manually," Anthropic says. "Developers can try Claude Ship on their own pull requests with the new /ship command in Claude Code," Anthropic says.
